description: Slews a changing control voltage over a fixed time rather than a fixed slope, so every move takes the same length of time whatever its size

params.text: Sets how long a move takes, 0 to 1 second, with a floor of ten samples

inputs.text: The changing voltage to be slewed, and its channel count sets the channel count of both outputs
Lengthens the glide by a fifth of a second per volt and shortens it by the same on negative voltage, over the slider setting

outputs.text: The input sliding toward each new value over the glide time
10V on a channel while that channel is sliding and 0V once it has arrived, despite the maker's tooltip calling it a gate at the end of the gliss

notes: a new target part way through a move turns the slide around from where it has reached rather than jumping to it.
